name: grid-list
title: Grid list
description: A list to move through with arrow keys and select from: rows with a visual, a title and status (`layout="stack"`), or tiles in a responsive grid with actions and drag to reorder (`layout="grid"`).

when: Records read as one line each, and tables on narrow screens (`layout="stack"`).
Items people recognize by an image: photos, documents, cards (`layout="grid"`).

instead.when: People compare several fields across records.
A plain choice of options in a form, not records to open.

keyboard.does: Move between rows, or between tiles in two dimensions.
Opens the focused row or tile.

builtIn: Sections are named for screen readers.
Tile actions are always visible, so they need no hover and work on touch.
A drag handle gives the keyboard a way to reorder tiles.
youProvide: A name for each tile action that names the tile.

GridList.name: children
GridList.description: GridListItem rows, or ListSections of them; or give `items` (or `sections`) and `renderItem`.

GridList.name: selectionBehavior
GridList.description:
How a press selects. `toggle` (default): each row has a checkbox and a press adds or
removes it, for picking a set to act on. `replace`: no checkboxes; a press selects that row in place of
the last, and with `single` the arrow keys move the selection, for a list that shows one open record
beside it (an inbox's conversation). The selected row keeps its marker either way. With `onAction` as
well, a press runs the action and selection needs the keyboard (React Aria's replace rule), so a
replace list usually leaves `onAction` out.

GridList.name: emptyState
GridList.description: Shown when there are no rows: an `EmptyState` or a sentence.

GridList.name: itemKey
GridList.description: The item's stable id; `item.id` by default.

GridList.name: dragAndDrop
GridList.type: { onReorder: (keys: Set<Key>, target: { key: Key; position: "before" | "after" }) => void }
GridList.description:
Reordering (photos): drag a tile, or focus its handle and use the keyboard. `onReorder` gets the moved
keys and the tile they go before or after.

GridList.name: ref
GridList.description:
The grid element. Focusing it focuses the tile React Aria keeps as focused (the next one after a removed tile),
so it is the `returnFocusRef` for a confirm whose action removes the tile it was opened from.

GridListItem.name: leading
GridListItem.description: A visual at the start: an Avatar, an icon or a thumbnail.

GridListItem.name: title
GridListItem.description: The one primary line ("Ada Lovelace"); also the row's text for typeahead.

GridListItem.name: description
GridListItem.description: The context the reader scans for: item, time, place ("Order 1042 · 10:00 · Berlin").

GridListItem.name: trailing
GridListItem.description: At the end: a Badge for status, then a subtle icon-button menu.

GridListItem.name: href
GridListItem.description: Makes the row a link to the record.
